Data extraction: XML element with attributes

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"<server id="main"><host>localhost</host></server>"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"xml"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.data.as_ref().unwrap().kind);
}
```
